ai.allowance_about: One budget for every AI feature. It starts again on the 1st of each month.
ai.by_day_about: Each day on your venue's clock.
ai.empty: No AI spend yet this month
ai.no_cap: Your plan sets no AI limit.
ai.over: Used up: the assistant hands every chat to your team and AI drafts stop until the 1st.

caption.ai: This month's AI spend against your plan's allowance.
caption.channels: Facebook Messenger pages and other channels for the inbox.

copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

email.about: Leave a field empty to use your organisation's name and email.
email.name: Sender name
email.owner_only: Only an owner can change this.
email.platform_tip: Emails go out from our checked address so they reach the inbox, not spam. Replies still come to you.
email.preview_about: What the next email from a lead's page carries.
email.reply_bad: This does not look like an email address.
email.saved: Saved. The next email carries it.

errors.brand_required: Add a brand before you connect a page.
errors.label_taken: You already have a token with this name.
errors.meta_call_failed: Facebook did not accept this. Try again, or reconnect the page.
errors.owner_only: Only an owner can change this.
errors.simulate_failed: The test message could not be delivered.
errors.too_many_tokens: You have the most tokens one person may hold. Revoke one first.

guide.about: Copy an example, or the whole guide for a developer or an AI.
guide.doc_honeypot: Add a hidden "honeypot" field to the form and drop what fills it: that stops most bots.
guide.doc_intro: Each form sent becomes a lead. Give this to your developer, or paste it into an AI assistant.
guide.doc_limit: At most 60 requests a minute per token.
guide.doc_replace: Replace YOUR_API_TOKEN with a token from Integrations → Lead intake. Keep it on your server, never in browser code.
guide.doc_response_line: 201 Created, or 200 when the same external_id was sent before:
guide.doc_server: Never put the token in a web page: send the form to your own server, which adds the token (example below).
guide.doc_title: Send your website forms to HexaTech CRM
guide.doc_web: A whole website example (the form and the server)
guide.f_amount: an order's value; 0 and EUR when left out
guide.f_brand: the brand the lead is for (ids below); left out, your default brand
guide.f_external_id: your own id for each sending: sent again, it returns the same lead
guide.f_source: a name for the form, e.g. "website_form"
guide.f_submitted_at: when it was sent; now when left out
guide.title: Connect your website
guide.token_fresh: Your new token is in the examples
guide.token_tip: Only put into the text you copy: it is not saved or sent anywhere.

line: Connect your website, email and messaging channels, and keep an eye on AI spend.

messenger.about: Messages to your Facebook page arrive in the inbox, where the assistant or your team answers.
messenger.connected: {{name}} is connected. Its messages arrive in the inbox.
messenger.disconnect_line: New messages to this page stop arriving in the inbox. The chats you have stay.
messenger.empty_line: You sign in with Facebook; we never see your password.
messenger.fb_blocked: Facebook could not be opened. An ad blocker may be stopping it.
messenger.fb_cancelled: Facebook login was closed before it finished.
messenger.needs_reconnect: The page needs to be reconnected.
messenger.no_pages: No page you manage with messaging access was found.
messenger.not_ready: Messenger is not switched on for your account yet. Ask HexaTech support to switch it on.
messenger.not_yours: This Facebook account does not manage {{name}}.
messenger.test_received: Test message received: see the inbox.
messenger.test_tip: A made-up message goes through the inbox and the assistant, without Facebook: it shows the rest works.
messenger.title: Facebook Messenger

tokens.about: A token lets another system send leads into this CRM, and nothing else. Each is yours; revoke it the moment it leaks.
tokens.empty_line: Make one for each website or system that sends you leads.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.name_characters: Use letters, digits, spaces, _ - and . only.
tokens.once: It is shown only now. Keep it on your server, never in a web page.
tokens.revoke_line: Any system using it stops sending leads at once.
tokens.revoked: Token revoked. Anything using it stops at once.
tokens.title: API tokens

whatsapp.about: WhatsApp messages do not arrive in the inbox yet. The chat widget can hand visitors to your WhatsApp number.
whatsapp.line: Visitors tap WhatsApp in the chat to reach your team.
whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
